po_items.definition: Number of purchase order items (cases). One case = one PO line (EBELN + EBELP).
po_items.caveats: Always filter is_in_scope (PO created from 2018-01-01, no event outside 2018-01-01..2019-01-31) unless asked otherwise.

po_value_eur.definition: Sum of net PO item value in EUR (net_value_eur).

conformance_rate.definition: Share of in-scope PO items where no deviation rule fires (has_deviation = false).
conformance_rate.sql: avg(case when has_deviation then 0 else 1 end) from marts.fct_po_item where is_in_scope
conformance_rate.caveats: The headline 'follows the target process' (77%) additionally requires model fit and uses the mature, closed cohort: analytics.case_conformance.

deviating_value_share.definition: Share of PO value on items with at least one deviation.

rework_item.definition: An item with a rework deviation: price change after invoice, quantity change after goods receipt, variance payment block, or a reversal.
rework_item.sql: dev_price_change_after_invoice or dev_quantity_change_after_gr or dev_payment_block or dev_reversal

control_gap.definition: Deviations that bypass a control without extra work: PO created after the invoice date, invoice paid before GR, invoice before GR, GR on a 2-way item, invoice on consignment.
control_gap.sql: dev_po_after_invoice or dev_paid_before_gr or dev_invoice_before_gr or dev_gr_on_two_way_item or dev_invoice_on_consignment
control_gap.caveats: Valued as exposed spend (EUR), never as effort.

first_time_right_rate.definition: Share of items with zero manual rework touches.
first_time_right_rate.sql: avg(case when n_manual_rework_touches = 0 then 1 else 0 end)

manual_touches.definition: Events performed by a named human SAP user; batch users and events without a user (e.g. Vendor creates invoice) are excluded.
manual_touches.sql: n_manual_touches in marts.fct_po_item; is_manual_touch in marts.fct_event

automation_rate.definition: Share of events executed by batch users.

cycle_days.definition: Days from PO creation to the case end (last clearing; last goods receipt for consignment) for closed items.
cycle_days.sql: cycle_days (closed items only); e2e_cycle_days measures from the first event of the case
cycle_days.caveats: Use is_closed; recent months are right-censored.

invoice_to_clear_days.definition: Days from first invoice receipt to the first clearing.

mature_cohort.definition: Items with at least 90 days of observation before the end of the log; used by the cost model and the early-warning model.

excess_touches.definition: Extra manual touches a deviation causes compared with a similar clean item, from OLS with fixed effects (analytics.deviation_effects, outcome n_manual_touches).
excess_touches.sql: select deviation_label, excess, ci_low, ci_high from analytics.deviation_effects where outcome = 'n_manual_touches'

cost_of_rework.definition: Yearly excess manual touches from rework deviations x cost per touch (5 / 15 / 30 EUR low / base / high).
cost_of_rework.sql: select sum(effort_saved_eur_base) from analytics.intervention_value where family = 'rework'

intervention_value.definition: Touches, item-days and EUR per year recovered if an intervention removes its deviations (analytics.intervention_value).

vendor_scorecard.definition: Per-vendor KPIs for vendors with at least 50 in-scope items (marts.mart_vendor_scorecard).

early_warning.definition: Risk score (probability of rework within 90 days) at PO creation, from a monthly-refitted LightGBM (analytics.early_warning_scores; analytics.model_metrics).
early_warning.caveats: Scores exist for test-period items (POs from 2018-08-01) only.
